# Moldova

The wealth gradients this library holds for Moldova: first the values to give OG-Core, then the measurements behind them. New to the terms? See the [glossary](../glossary.md).

## What to use in OG-Core

| OG-Core input | Tilt | From |
|---|---|---|
| `fert_gradient` | **by age**, table below (fertility tilt −0.52 plus the [age offsets](../methods/fertility-by-age.md)) | DHS 2005 |
| `infmort_gradient` | **−0.27** | DHS 2005 |
| `mort_gradient` | 1.29 − 0.244 × ln(GNI per person); e.g. −0.40 at $1,000, −0.79 at $5,000 | [general gradient](../methods/general-gradient.md) (no census measurement) |
| `imm_pctiles` | not covered by this library | — |

Every value is a **tilt** ([what that is](../glossary.md#tilt)). Convert it before passing it to OG-Core: `tilt / (100 × (1 − p))`, with p OG-Core's own rate at that age ([how](../methods/ogcore-units.md)).

**Fertility tilt by mother's age** (for `fert_gradient`; ages under 15 take the 15–19 value, 50 and over the 45–49 value):

| 15–19 | 20–24 | 25–29 | 30–34 | 35–39 | 40–44 | 45–49 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| −1.30 | −0.62 | −0.31 | −0.20 | −0.43 | −0.92 | −1.51 |

## Where these numbers come from

### Household surveys (DHS)

Latest survey, from [`data/gradient_library_latest.csv`](../../data/gradient_library_latest.csv). Earlier surveys are in `gradient_library.csv`.

| Measure | Survey | Tilt | Poorest ÷ richest tenth | Poorest fifth → richest fifth |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Births per woman (TFR) | 2005 | **−0.52** | 1.5× | 2.1 · 1.9 · 1.8 · 1.5 · 1.4 |
| Infant deaths per 1,000 births (IMR) | 2005 | **−0.27** | 1.2× | 20 · 21 · 29 · 19 · 16 |
| Under-5 deaths per 1,000 births (U5MR) | 2005 | **−0.65** | 1.7× | 29 · 28 · 33 · 22 · 17 |
